model_approximations: Sliding-group residency is a fixed steady-state estimate, not a native active-step upper bound.
Temporary prefill residency is not simulated; a full-context retention bound checks nonbinding capacity.
The PP1 retention bound includes two complete unsettled verify rounds plus draft proposal lookahead.
Integer token-byte rounding changes reported bytes slightly; physical pool block count is unchanged.
This fixed-length prefix-disabled mapping does not qualify AgentX prefix reuse or P/D transfer.
Checkpoint weights use immutable shared revision directory and pinned config; full weight contents were not rehashed.
Replay reuses vLLM0.24 op tables, token-basis target attention and HCA draft-SWA proxy; these remain prediction error sources.
Frontend and graph replay host gaps are not explicitly modeled.
Per-request server seed42 repeats the synthetic RNG trajectory; Replay samples its adjacent-integer control with seed42, not the exact serving RNG sequence.
Acceptance counters are recorded separately; the frozen mean is not fitted to their realization.
